title: Decide what TimeSync is before specifying how it works
question: Should TimeSync primarily be a protocol, a time-state specification, a risk/governance profile, an orchestration architecture, or a deliberate combination?
why_now: This decision will strongly constrain architecture, interface design, deployment expectations, and validation strategy.
next_best_moves: Collect 3-5 real deployment archetypes that need trustworthy timing.
Draft competing candidate identities for TimeSync and compare them against the same scenarios.
Delay deep protocol design until the identity question is materially clearer.
evidence_needed: Scenario matrix across multiple sectors or deployment classes.
A comparison note showing what each candidate identity can and cannot solve.
At least one first-pass consumer model describing what downstream systems actually need.
